# NDVI

```{r}
library(sf)
```

# Convert PPW .kmz to a geojson for use in GEE
```{r}
# 1. Set your KMZ file path
kmz_filename <- "E://PepperwoodPlotLocations//PepperwoodPlotLocations//2021_plot_locations.kmz"

# 2. Define temporary unzip directory and output name (in same folder as KMZ)
kmz_folder <- dirname(kmz_filename)
unzip_dir <- "extracted_kml_temp"
output_geojson <- file.path(kmz_folder, "ppw_plots.geojson")

# 3. R automatically unzips the KMZ to extract the KML data
unzip(kmz_filename, exdir = unzip_dir)

# 4. R finds the newly extracted .kml file automatically
kml_file <- list.files(unzip_dir, pattern = "\\.kml$", full.names = TRUE)

# 5. Check available layers in the KML file
layers <- st_layers(kml_file)
print(layers)

# 6. Read the data into R (specify the layer you want)
# Using the first layer, or change to a specific layer name if needed
plot_data <- st_read(kml_file, layer = layers$name[1])

# 7. Convert to GeoJSON and export (keeps 3D coordinates)
st_write(plot_data, dsn = output_geojson, driver = "GeoJSON")
```
